scope: Default native static input/cache capture only; no source emission or transport. Not a finite-source physical trial or an accepted optical working point.

sampling.weights: Original quadrature probability 1/N; no transmitted-current restoration
sampling.refinement: Append CDF samples using the same inverse marginal maps; no propagated-trajectory interpolation

energy_interpolation.method: np.interp piecewise linear monotone shape-to-kinetic-energy map
energy_interpolation.table_inputs: Physical energy parameters only; independent of ray count, sampled extrema, seed, or transmitted particles
energy_interpolation.bound_scope: Exact logistic second-derivative interpolation bound; separate binary64 evaluation roundoff is checked at table midpoints
energy_interpolation.cdf_tail_policy: Retain the existing fixed Young 1e-15 and logistic 1e-12 endpoint clipping, followed by fixed symmetric shape bounds; no sample-dependent tail fitting

sampling.energy_width_definition: Configured FWHM is the existing RMS-equivalent width, 2.354820045 times continuous-law standard deviation
sampling.energy_moment_scope: The fixed continuous CDF law is calibrated once per physical parameter set; finite-N moments are observed and are never fitted or renormalized
sampling.legacy_scope: An absent sampling record retains legacy batch-dependent energy calibration; it is not relabelled as this schema
